js: 'Side panels in both engines with html.tauri set (the app window\'s classic scrollbars): the Conversations list never scrolls sideways at any window width or panel width, and every side panel\'s drag handle (SplitPane) resizes it: a live drag that stops at the panel\'s floor and at what leaves the main pane its floor, the width kept across a reload, a click that is not a drag storing nothing, double-click and Enter back to the automatic width, the arrow keys, Home and End, a window narrower than the chosen width showing it narrower without forgetting it. Conversations, Thread settings (a thread is open: the first in the list) and the Audio lab\'s library. Read-only: only localStorage changes, and the drive removes what it set. Pointer and key events are dispatched in the page (no trusted input in webkit-check). Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/split-resize.json --block-writes --dsf 1.25 --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr>, or scripts/webkit-check.py --backend broadway --zoom 1.25 --timeout 1500 --drive scripts/drive/split-resize.json --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr>.'
